guide.summary: Beaches, a cable car, city museums and a converted factory complex, with breakfast buffets, bakeries, hotel dinners and cocktail lounges checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: The Busan Museum of Art, the Museum of Contemporary Art Busan and the Busan Modern and Contemporary History Museum all close on Mondays and 1 January, and on the next day when a Monday is a public holiday, so plan museum days for Tuesday to Sunday.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Busan Museum of Art, the Museum of Contemporary Art Busan and the Busan Modern and Contemporary History Museum close on Mondays and 1 January, and on the next day when a Monday is a public holiday. At F1963, Kukje Gallery Busan and Eobo Jechulso also close on Mondays.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Busan Air Cruise lists an adult Air Cruise round trip at 19,000 won and stops selling tickets 30 minutes before closing. Haeundae Blue Line Park and SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium both sell tickets on their own sites, and SEA LIFE offers up to 31% off when you book online in advance.

toolkit.label: Queues and tours
toolkit.value: Pay to skip, register to join
toolkit.copy: Busan Air Cruise sells a no-wait Speedy Cruise at 45,000 won (Air) or 55,000 won (Crystal) per person. The Busan Modern and Contemporary History Museum's permanent-exhibition tours need online registration and take 15 people per session.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: General admission at the Museum of Contemporary Art Busan is free, but some special exhibitions charge, and exemptions for under-7s with a guardian or visitors 65 and over apply only with documents. At Haeundae Beach, between 1 September and 31 May you may not enter the water from 30 minutes after sunset until 30 minutes before sunrise.

guide.dek: Keep museum days to Tuesday through Sunday, and save Haeundae for the beach train, the aquarium and an evening drink.
intro: This Busan guide is built around the sea and the city's public museums, each checked on its own website. Haeundae Beach is run by the Haeundae-gu Office, whose directions page puts it an eight-minute walk from Exit 5 of Haeundae Station on Line 2. During the non-opening period, from 1 September to 31 May the following year, you may not enter the water from 30 minutes after sunset until 30 minutes before sunrise. East of the beach, Haeundae Blue Line Park runs its beach train from Mipo Station and takes bookings online.

The Busan Museum of Art on APEC-ro opens Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 to 18:00, with last entry to the main building at 17:00. Busan city lists its collection exhibition "Dear All The Yesterdays" from 17 September 2026 to 14 March 2027, with free admission. The Museum of Contemporary Art Busan in Saha-gu keeps the same hours and makes general admission free, though some special exhibitions charge. In Jung-gu, the free Busan Modern and Contemporary History Museum opens 09:00 to 18:00 and runs permanent-exhibition tours that need online registration and take 15 people.

F1963, a converted factory complex in Suyeong-gu, gathers several stops at one address. Terarosa there opens daily from 09:00 to 21:00 and bakes naturally leavened bread each day, Praha993 brews Czech-style beer until 22:30, and Michael's Urban Farm Table serves on the fourth-floor rooftop with a break from 14:30 to 17:00. Kukje Gallery Busan and Eobo Jechulso close on Mondays. The complex lists Jean-Michel Othoniel's "In the Labyrinth of Love" from 28 August to 31 December 2026.

For dinners and cocktails, hotel outlets publish the clearest details. The Westin Josun Busan on Dongbaek-ro lists Panorama Lounge daily from 08:00 to midnight, Camellia's buffet breakfast from 06:30 to 10:00, and Josun Deli from 08:00 to 22:00. Grand Josun Busan serves an autumn Chinese course at Palais de Chine until 30 November 2026, and its outdoor lawn is being improved until 30 December 2026. Lotte Hotel Busan pairs La Seine's buffet of more than 140 dishes with Delica Hans, which sells bread and cakes baked the same day.
summaryCards: Pair Haeundae Beach with the Blue Line Park beach train from Mipo Station, then finish at Panorama Lounge in The Westin Josun Busan.
Start with breakfast at Camellia or bread at Terarosa (F1963), which opens at 09:00, before an unhurried look round F1963.

Keep museum visits to Tuesday through Sunday, because the Busan Museum of Art, the Museum of Contemporary Art Busan and the Busan Modern and Contemporary History Museum close on Mondays and 1 January.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Haedong Yonggungsa (connection refused), Jagalchi Market (HTTP 520), Busan Museum and the Busan Facilities Corporation site for Busan Tower and Taejongdae (connection reset), Momos Coffee and Park Hyatt Busan (HTTP 403), and Busan X the Sky, Busan Cinema Center and Paradise Hotel Busan (no readable content) could not be read, so they are left out; none of this is evidence of closure. Gamcheon Culture Village showed no notices newer than 2022, and the National Maritime Museum's pages gave hours but no street address while its website is suspended from 26 October to 28 December 2026. Haeundae Beach has directions but no street address on its official page. Hours were not published for Haeundae Blue Line Park or the Signiel Busan, Lotte Hotel Busan and Grand Josun Busan outlets; Busan Air Cruise and SEA LIFE showed only that day's hours. F1963 tenants were confirmed through the complex's own site, and The Westin Josun Busan outlets through Marriott's hotel page, which carried no dated 2026 notices. The Busan Citizens Park History Museum is closed from 2 to 16 November 2026 to install a new exhibition.
